title: Plan recruitment of the MVP-gate Safety Engineer and advisory reviewers
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers; optional clip-on Shoulder Module or one-piece Integrated Harness) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards (cite by number and title only), never name private individuals or incident victims, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. Nothing can be released without a named, credentialed Safety Engineer (GOVERNANCE.md role 2). Recruitment is the critical path.
objective: Produce a recruitment plan: candidate pools (ASTM F24 members, NAARSO/AIMS-affiliated engineers, occupant-restraint and fall-protection engineering firms, university ride-engineering programs), selection criteria, an outreach template, and a conflict-of-interest checklist.
acceptanceCriteria: At least 6 candidate pools or organisations, each with a public URL and why it fits
Outreach template states scope, time estimate, independence requirements and that the project is open/unpaid (or how compensation could work)
Names organisations and public roles only, never private individuals
Every factual claim has a cited, working source link; estimates are labelled as estimates
